layout.halo: 198 words as GatherJob writes them: [0..2] row 63 of chunks (cx-1..cx+1, cy-1); [3..194] rows 0..63 of chunks (cx-1..cx+1, cy), three words per row; [195..197] row 0 of chunks (cx-1..cx+1, cy+1).
layout.rows: Chunk rows count upward (row 0 is the bottom, world y = chunkOrigin.y + row). Within a chunk row word, the most significant bit is column 0 (leftmost).
layout.pairs: A pair [word0, word1] is one 66-column halo row: word0 holds columns 0..63 with the most significant bit = column 0, one left of the chunk; word1 holds columns 64..65 in its two most significant bits. previous/current/next are halo rows row, row+1, row+2.
layout.planes: afterPrevious/afterNext/afterCurrent: neighbour-count bit-planes after each of Compute's three AddBits steps, as [b0, b1, b2] of word0 then [b0, b1, b2] of word1.
layout.source: Assets/Scripts/BitmaskKernel.cs, Compute (via TraceRow, checked against it)
